latest.notes: Fixes the weather-swap. Three bugs, found from the new Diagnostics trace: the top of the hour left the element it stepped over sitting pending in the log; a stall then recovered into that stranded row, airing it three quarters of an hour late and pushing the weather segment in behind it; and removing a segment from the on-air log removed only its container row, so the segment vanished from the screen and aired anyway. Elements dropped at the top of the hour now show in Errors and Skips with a reason.
